    private void swingAt(int tick, int actor) {
        this.at(tick, () -> this.swing(actor));
    }

    private ItemStack starringTag() {
        var tag = new ItemStack(Items.NAME_TAG);
        tag.set(net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME, this.player().getName());
        return tag;
    }

    private String starringSkin() {
        return DamageTesterEntity.SKIN_PLAYER_PREFIX + this.player().getName().getString();
    }

    private void costume(int tester, ItemStack prop) {
        this.cmd("gamemode creative @a");
        this.srv(level -> {
            var player = this.player();
            player.setItemInHand(InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, prop);
            ((DamageTesterEntity) this.entity(level, tester)).interact(player, InteractionHand.MAIN_HAND, Vec3.ZERO);
        });
        this.cmd("gamemode spectator @a");
    }

    private void snowBurst(int tester) {
        this.srv(level -> {
            var subject = this.entity(level, tester);
            level.sendParticles(ParticleTypes.SNOWFLAKE, subject.getX(), subject.getY() + 1.1,
                subject.getZ(), 35, .52, .46, .42, .05);
        });
    }
